children: The Bank of England announced on Thursday that it had allotted a record £143.083 billion ($191.80 billion) in seven-day funds in its weekly short-term repo operation, higher than a previous record of £140.845 billion set last week.
The central bank is using increasingly its short-term repo operations to provide banks with reserves as it runs down its stockpile of government bonds bought under its quantitative easing programme.
